title: Optimization Encoding
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number such that $\mathrm{Fin}(q)$ is nonempty, and let an encoded regular Unique Games family with alphabet size $q$ be given. An optimization encoding consists of an encoded maximization problem such that its valid inputs are exactly the canonical encodings of semantic instances in the family, and such that for every semantic instance its encoded optimum equals the optimum of the associated finite Unique Games constraint satisfaction problem.
hypotheses_covered: an encoded regular Unique Games family with alphabet size $q$ is given
